name: Gyome, Master Chef
oracle_text:
Trample
At the beginning of your end step, create a number of Food tokens equal to the number of nontoken creatures you had enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
{1}, Sacrifice a Food: Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a number of Food tokens equal to the number of nontoken creatures you had enter the battlefield under your control this turn.

needs.what: an `is_token` clause on the `permanents_entered_this_turn` value, so it can count only NONTOKEN creatures that entered under your control this turn: `{"permanents_entered_this_turn": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "is_token": false}}`. EnteredPermanent would need to snapshot whether the arrival was a token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: permanents_entered_this_turn filters only on controller, types, not_types, subtypes, colors and exclude_self (ENTERED_FILTER_KEYS), and EnteredPermanent records no token flag, so it would also count creature tokens and make extra Food. A `count` over the battlefield with `entered_this_turn` and `is_token: false` misses creatures that entered and then died or left before the end step, which is the case the ledger value exists for
